pr_title: Added figsize for autocorrelation_plot and lag_plot (#31650)
pr_body:
- closes #31650
- Passed pandas.tests.plotting.test_misc.py
- Now creating new axes with "fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 1, figsize=figsize)"
- Also changed plotting.lag_plot regarding the same issue
- Figure size is only changed if no axis parameter is given
pr_comments: @jqmviegas do we have tests that cover all of the changed code?  codecov seems to think not

> @jqmviegas do we have tests that cover all of the changed code? codecov seems to think not

@jbrockmendel  Added checks using the _check_plot_works(...) with the figsize keyword but I'm not sure if that does the trick. Unsure how to improve testing regarding this issue.
Running coverage.py indicates that everything is covered in the methods I worked on.

@jbrockmendel I'm almost sure that this is the result of the CI running the fast tests. The tests for the methods I worked on are decorated with @pytest.mark.slow. I was able to reproduce the results of codecov/patch running the following:

`pytest --cov=pandas --skip-slow pandas/tests/plotting/test_misc.py`

This returns:

```

```

Running the full tests with:

`pytest --cov=pandas pandas/tests/plotting/test_misc.py`

```

-------------------------------------------------------------------------
...
pandas/plotting/_matplotlib/misc.py           269     52    81%   63-69, 113, 187, 202-256, 332, 340-342, 344-348
```

No missing lines include the functions autocorrelation_plot or lag_plot.
